adoption: Separate per-member execution sessions and a canonical shared transcript; Ngertiin keeps its existing application authority and SQLite event/receipt store.
Context-based responder selection in an isolated model session. Ngertiin selects one valid member, rejects invalid/stale output and omits routing/pass messages from group history.
Trusted tool caller scope and explicit task lineage for handoff/review; user requests bind to a durable task/run/request revision.
Replay and mailbox reconciliation read durable state before admitting a continuation. Unknown native outcomes are held for receipt reconciliation, without resubmission.
not_adopted: Multi-human access, cloud/mobile notifications, desktop UI, messaging platforms, fallback models and advanced provider routing.
Openbot routing selection messages, broad automatic memory inclusion and optional temporary subagents.

upgrade: Diff the four pinned modules and their referenced channel/attention contracts. Preserve one application lifecycle, member validation after asynchronous native work, independent routing/member/DM sessions, source-run lineage, stable receipts and unknown-effect fencing. Re-run domain/protocol/process fixtures and the cross-harness native handoff/HITL/restart cohort; keep billing and tool capabilities explicit.
